secret.description: Ezekiel Hargrove hands a parcel of stolen goods to a man at the Kitchen at 10:00 PM.

people.name: Margaret Rafferty

secret.description: Margaret Rafferty is alone with Beatrice Crowninshield in the Victim's Suite from 9:00 PM to 10:00 PM, and kills Beatrice Crowninshield at 10:00 PM.

motive.description: was about to be exposed by the victim

method.name: a gunshot

Margaret Rafferty says Eunice Prentiss was there. Eunice Prentiss says otherwise: Eunice Prentiss was on the Service Stairs at 9:00 PM, not at the Front Desk.
Beatrice Crowninshield was found in the Victim's Suite. The coroner puts death between 9:30 PM and 10:00 PM. One bullet below the sternum. Powder burns on the shirt front: fired close.
A nickel-plated revolver is missing from the Front Desk. The drawer it was kept in is open and the oiled cloth is still in it.
The passenger elevator was out of order from 6:30 PM to 7:00 PM. Anyone changing floors in that time used the service stairs.
The service stairs were whitewashed that afternoon. There is whitewash on Beatrice Crowninshield's sleeve; Beatrice Crowninshield was on the stairs at 6:30 PM.
The service stairs were whitewashed that afternoon. There is whitewash on Grafton Havemeyer's sleeve; Grafton Havemeyer was on the stairs at 7:00 PM.
The service stairs were whitewashed that afternoon. There is whitewash on Delia Brennan's sleeve; Delia Brennan was on the stairs at 6:30 PM.
Found in the Front Desk: A clipping about the failure of Hedwig Kreuzer's business, with Beatrice Crowninshield's name underlined twice in pencil.
Grafton Havemeyer says Hedwig Kreuzer said Beatrice Crowninshield had taken everything and would be made to feel it.
Found in the Victim's Suite: A subpoena naming Beatrice Crowninshield as a witness before the grand jury, with Delia Brennan's name written in the margin.
Winthrop Winslow says Beatrice Crowninshield said to Delia Brennan that a man who testifies sleeps better.
Found in the Front Desk: A lease assignment made out in Eunice Prentiss's name, waiting only on Beatrice Crowninshield's signature.
Ellsworth Coffin says Beatrice Crowninshield told Eunice Prentiss the lease would go to somebody else at the quarter day.
Found in the Front Desk: A typed page of dates and sums in Beatrice Crowninshield's file, headed with Margaret Rafferty's name.
Grafton Havemeyer says Beatrice Crowninshield told Margaret Rafferty that the story would run whether Margaret Rafferty liked it or not.
